===Quests===
If players wish to make use of the permanent portal to Puro-Puro found on Zanaris, completion of [[Lost City]] will be required. Having partial completion of [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]] is recommended in order to gain access to [[fairy rings]]. No quest is required however to gain passage to Puro-Puro through one of the crop circles that roam the surface of Gielinor.
